title: Never RM Dash RF (Quarantine Doctrine)
style: doctrine anthem, slow tempo march, 76 bpm, restraint vibe, deep cello drone, controlled vocal, ops discipline rap, no-purge core, deadpan zen
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ten TODELETE folders found across the disk
Quarantine staging not a purge risk
Zynthio guard doctrine never rm dash rf
Operator decides when the trash gets the cliff

[Pre-Chorus]
Three macOS resource forks dot underscore tagged
Seven real folders staging flagged

[Chorus]
Never rm dash rf never rm dash rf
The doctrine holds the line never the bluff
Quarantine staging operator's call
Not touched this session that's the wall

[Verse 2]
From orico backup folders three deep dated
Incoming desktop zynthio tools curated
From google drive final handover memory
All TODELETE all standing in inventory

[Bridge]
The doctrine doesn't trust the agent's hand
Quarantine first the operator commands

[Outro]
Never rm dash rf never rm dash rf
The line holds the staging never gets rough
